description: Critical-path coverage for live acceptance journeys. CriticalPathCoverageTests checks this file against the Gateway route catalog in every PR build. Each Gateway operation under a watched prefix must be covered by the journey or listed in outOfPath with a reason. A route whose path contains the text of a gap fails the build until the journey covers it.
